subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customers, we are excited to announce that we have added new payment options to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now pay using major credit cards, PayPal, and even cryptocurrency. We hope these additional options will make your transactions smoother and hassle-free. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs.
